author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407 This is a good start for the word sort lesson plan and qualifies for the badge but some brief feedback, be careful randomly picking numbers and calling it mastery. Why is 80% correct mastery. Who conflated a B to meaning success? What if all four mistakes were on the same type of phonics pattern. Did the student master the lesson?

We make up and do dumb stuff with numbers all the time in education. Grading is no different. Is 16/20 so different than 15/20?

Also you need to encourage greater reflection around the phonics rules governing the spelling.
